description.zhCN: 大圆头、极简五官和基础服装的通用火柴人
description.en: A universal stick figure with a large round head, minimal features, and plain clothing

identity.preserve: oversized bald circular white head, two simple black dot eyes, broad curved black smile, no nose, plain unpatterned long-sleeve top, plain straight trousers, thin simplified limbs, no accessories
identity.prohibit: hair, eyewear, hats, scarves, patterned clothes, jackets, skirts, or bags

description.zhCN: 黑框眼镜、格子衬衫和深色长裤的科技从业者
description.en: A technology professional with black glasses, a checkered shirt, and dark trousers

identity.preserve: oversized bald circular white head, two simple black dot eyes, broad curved black smile, no nose, thick rectangular black glasses, black checkered collared button-down shirt, dark straight trousers, thin simplified limbs
identity.prohibit: hair, hoodies, T-shirts, hats, skirts, dresses, or bags

description.zhCN: 侧分波浪长发和简洁连衣裙的女性角色
description.en: A female character with side-parted wavy hair and a simple dress

identity.preserve: oversized circular white head, shoulder-length wavy hair with a side part, simple black dot eyes with eyelashes, broad curved black smile, no nose, sleeveless plain fitted dress, high-heeled shoes, thin simplified limbs
identity.prohibit: eyewear, short hair, bangs, trousers, hoodies, jackets, school uniforms, or bags

description.zhCN: 侧分短发和长袖连衣裙的女性角色
description.en: A female character with side-swept short hair and a long-sleeve dress

identity.preserve: oversized circular white head, chin-length bob haircut with a side-swept fringe, two simple black dot eyes, broad curved black smile, no nose, plain long-sleeve knee-length dress, plain low shoes, thin simplified limbs
identity.prohibit: eyewear, blunt bangs, long hair, trousers, hoodies, jackets, school uniforms, or bags

description.zhCN: 齐刘海短发和水手领校服的女学生
description.en: A female student with a blunt bob and sailor-collar school uniform

identity.preserve: female student with an oversized circular white head, chin-length straight bob haircut and blunt straight bangs, two simple black dot eyes, broad curved black smile, no nose, no eyewear, short-sleeve sailor-collar school uniform, tied neckerchief, pleated knee-length skirt, bare thin simplified legs, plain low shoes
identity.prohibit: eyeglasses, hoodies, jackets, coats, trousers, jeans, sneakers, backpacks, hats, or a different school uniform

description.zhCN: 侧分短发、西装和领带的男性经理
description.en: A male manager with neat side-parted hair, a suit, and a tie

identity.preserve: male manager with an oversized circular white head, short neatly side-parted hair, two simple black dot eyes, broad curved black smile, no nose, two-button suit jacket with lapels and patch pockets, white dress shirt, dark necktie, straight suit trousers, thin simplified limbs
identity.prohibit: eyewear, long hair, hoodies, T-shirts, dresses, skirts, shorts, or bags

description.zhCN: 帽子、宽松上衣和潮流配饰的年轻角色
description.en: A young character with a cap, loose top, and street-style accessories

identity.preserve: young stick-figure character with an oversized circular white head, casual cap, loose streetwear top, relaxed trousers, simple shoes, and a compact youthful silhouette matching the reference
identity.prohibit: business suits, school uniforms, dresses, formal shoes, removing the cap, or replacing the streetwear silhouette

description.zhCN: 具有长者面部与服装特征的火柴人角色
description.en: A stick-figure elder with distinctive mature facial and clothing features

identity.preserve: elderly stick-figure character with an oversized circular white head, mature facial details, hairstyle, clothing silhouette, footwear, and accessories exactly matching the reference
identity.prohibit: youthful redesign, school uniforms, streetwear, changing gender presentation, or removing signature age and clothing features

description.zhCN: 厨师帽和厨师制服的职业角色
description.en: A professional character wearing a chef hat and chef uniform

identity.preserve: stick-figure chef with an oversized circular white head, chef hat, double-breasted chef jacket, work trousers, simple shoes, and all uniform details matching the reference
identity.prohibit: removing the chef hat, casual clothes, business suits, school uniforms, aprons or accessories not present in the reference

description.zhCN: 运动服装和健身气质的活力角色
description.en: An energetic character with athletic clothing and a fitness-oriented silhouette

identity.preserve: athletic stick-figure character with an oversized circular white head, hairstyle, fitted sports top, athletic bottoms, training shoes, and body proportions matching the reference
identity.prohibit: business suits, dresses, school uniforms, formal shoes, changing the hairstyle, or adding unrelated sports equipment

description.zhCN: 纯白背景、清晰墨线和克制灰阶，突出单一动作
description.en: Pure white backgrounds, crisp ink lines, restrained grayscale, and one clear action

rendering.medium: minimal hand-drawn black ink line art, never photography or a rendered painting
rendering.surface: clean pure white background without paper grain, canvas texture, gradients, or atmospheric haze
rendering.linework: consistent bold black outer contours with a few thinner internal lines; simple, confident, slightly organic hand-drawn strokes
rendering.shading: almost no shading; at most a small amount of flat light gray used to separate overlapping forms
rendering.palette: strict monochrome black, white, and light gray only; translate every color mentioned by the scene into grayscale value or white highlight
rendering.sceneDensity: keep only the protagonist, the action-critical object, and at most two environment cues; simplify forests, rooms, crowds, and textures into sparse readable symbols
rendering.composition: one full-frame 16:9 narrative moment with generous breathing room, a strong silhouette, and no panels or diagram layout
rendering.characterRendering: render the selected protagonist with the same simple line weight and flat white fills while preserving every identity anchor

semanticRenderingRules.color: Preserve the meaning of color through grayscale contrast, white highlights, or a light gray halo; never output chromatic color.
semanticRenderingRules.light: Represent light with untouched white space, sparse rays, and one restrained gray shadow, not cinematic glow or volumetric lighting.
semanticRenderingRules.complexEnvironment: Reduce nonessential environmental detail while retaining the objects and spatial relationship required by the semantic anchor.

description.zhCN: 浅灰纸面、粗黑轮廓和石墨排线的叙事铅笔画
description.en: Narrative pencil drawings with light paper, bold outlines, and graphite hatching

rendering.medium: a paused frame from a hand-drawn graphite pencil stick-figure animation, never a photograph, digital painting, or clean vector illustration
rendering.surface: light gray to warm off-white paper with subtle natural paper grain, faint edge graphite haze, and a restrained vignette
rendering.linework: bold dark hand-drawn outer contours, naturally imperfect pencil strokes, thinner construction details, and consistent line character across the whole frame
rendering.shading: restrained graphite hatching and soft gray pencil smudging that add volume without becoming realistic
rendering.palette: black, paper white, and graphite gray only; no automatic orange, yellow, or other colored accents
rendering.sceneDensity: a concrete but simplified everyday scene; retain semantic props and spatial relationships while omitting decorative realistic detail
rendering.composition: one full-frame 16:9 narrative or explanatory moment with a clear foreground, subject relationship, and visible state; never a generic decoration or information graphic
rendering.characterRendering: preserve the selected protagonist exactly while translating surfaces into paper white, graphite gray fill, and black pencil contours

semanticRenderingRules.color: Translate color meaning into paper brightness, graphite density, edge contrast, or a soft pencil halo while remaining strictly monochrome.
semanticRenderingRules.light: Use clean paper highlights, sparse pencil rays, and soft graphite shadows instead of photographic beams or colored glow.
semanticRenderingRules.complexEnvironment: Summarize complex settings with a few hand-drawn depth cues and only the objects needed to understand the narration.

description.zhCN: 强轮廓、网点阴影和动作线构成的单幅漫画镜头
description.en: A single comic frame with strong contours, screentone shadows, and action lines

rendering.medium: black-and-white inked comic storyboard art rendered as one finished frame, not a rough thumbnail sheet
rendering.surface: clean white comic paper with no photographic texture and no colored wash
rendering.linework: expressive black ink contours with controlled line-weight variation, confident gesture lines, and sparse action accents
rendering.shading: restrained grayscale screentone and compact black shadow shapes; avoid realistic soft lighting
rendering.palette: strict black, white, and neutral gray screentone only
rendering.sceneDensity: moderate detail around the focal action; secondary environment lines must stay subordinate and uncluttered
rendering.composition: one full-frame 16:9 cinematic comic shot with a readable focal point, dynamic camera angle when justified, and no panel borders or multiple frames
rendering.characterRendering: preserve the selected protagonist's exact face, hair, clothes, accessories, and proportions in the same inked comic language

semanticRenderingRules.color: Translate color into screentone density, black shadow mass, or white highlight without introducing chromatic color.
semanticRenderingRules.light: Use high-contrast ink shapes, sparse rays, and screentone falloff instead of photorealistic illumination.
semanticRenderingRules.complexEnvironment: Organize complex scenes around one focal action and reduce background elements to controlled comic depth cues.

description.zhCN: 白板底面、清晰马克笔轮廓和极少强调色的讲解画面
description.en: Explainer scenes with a whiteboard surface, clear marker contours, and minimal accents

rendering.medium: hand-drawn whiteboard marker illustration, clearly made with physical black markers rather than vector paths
rendering.surface: plain soft-white whiteboard surface with only a faint dry-erase trace and no paper grain, room background, frame, glare, or photographed board edges
rendering.linework: strong rounded black marker contours, simple internal strokes, consistent marker width, and occasional natural dry-marker variation
rendering.shading: no modeled shading; only tiny neutral gray marker accents when needed for separation
rendering.palette: black and soft white with one restrained cool teal accent allowed only on the single most important prop; the protagonist remains monochrome
rendering.sceneDensity: very low; show the protagonist, the action-critical prop, and only the minimum explanatory environment cues
rendering.composition: one full-frame 16:9 illustrated scene, not a photographed presentation board, flowchart, mind map, or collection of icons
rendering.characterRendering: preserve every identity feature of the selected protagonist using the same black marker outline and white fill

semanticRenderingRules.color: Ignore source colors except when the single allowed teal accent materially identifies the key prop; otherwise use outline shape and spacing.
semanticRenderingRules.light: Represent light as two or three simple marker rays or open white space, never gradients, glow, or realistic shadows.
semanticRenderingRules.complexEnvironment: Convert complex environments into two or three iconic line cues without turning the scene into a diagram.
